caseName: National Ass'n for the Advancement of Colored People v. Hampton County Election Commission
caseNameFull: National Association for the Advancement of Colored People v. Hampton County Election Commission

opinions.text:
D. C. S. C. [Probable jurisdiction noted, 467 U. S. 1250.] Motion of the Solicitor General for leave to participate in oral argument as amicus curiae and for divided argument granted.

Justice Marshall took no part in the consideration or decision of this motion.
